# Vendored `deepmerge` 4.3.2

Upstream `deepmerge@4.3.1` is the last npm release and is affected by
[GHSA-gcqx-w48m-w2h4](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-gcqx-w48m-w2h4)
(prototype poisoning). No patched release exists on the registry yet.

This directory is `4.3.1` plus the `setProperty` fix from
[TehShrike/deepmerge#277](https://github.com/TehShrike/deepmerge/pull/277),
versioned as `4.3.2` so Dependabot treats the alert as resolved. Remove this
vendor tree and the `file:vendor/deepmerge` dependency once upstream publishes
a fixed release.
